title: Transcription Guidelines
rules:
Transcription is the
commitment of an audio
signal to textual
representation. This can
include representing speech
data as well as other sound
types such as phones ringing
or music. In order to train
machine intelligence
transcription systems, the
training data must be of
high quality.

Segment BEFORE
transcription​

Each Speech segment
= one speaker only​

If speakers overlap
heavily → Babble
segment​

Silence ≥ 1 second →
keep segment, mark
later as [no-speech]​

Audio: Speaker A talks, Speaker B
interrupts​

Create TWO Speech segments​

Do NOT mix speakers in one
segment​

Overlapping part handled later with
<overlap> tags​
